text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow's Senior year
finally begins—
Today, I came to pay the first shrine visit of the New Year together with Bubble Gum Fellow and the rest of the Heavenly Kings.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
—Visiting the shrine for the New Year in our school uniforms like this...
this year will be our last, won't it?

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, hearing that really makes me feel lonely...
You're moving out of the dorms at the end of the school year too, right...?

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'll have work over there right away starting in April, after all.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...Dad said he's looking forward
to working with Waltz."

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm honored. ...However, while I remain at the academy,
I intend to continue doing everything I can to support you.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
The "Limit Break Plan" I made with Bubble's Trainer.
I will make sure to see it through to success.

The 'Limit Break Plan.'
A plan to forge a resilient body so Bubble Gum Fellow's subconscious limiter won't kick in.
All members of the Big Four had been cooperating with this plan with all their might since last year—

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
That plan will not only benefit Bubble,
but also contribute greatly to our own future growth.
...My hands are itching to get to work.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
We're counting on you, our strategist.
We need your calm, rational perspective, Cure.

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
âAh, it's almost our turn to pray!
Let's go, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Then shall we pray together
for a breakthrough in the Senior year?

And so, after finishing our Hatsumode visit
safely with Bubble Gum Fellow and the others—
—On the way home.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Hmm, it's pretty crowded... Is it because of the New Year?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, how do you think this year's races will turn out?
Do you think the 'Big Four' will show up in the Senior Class?”

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text: Man, that's gonna be tough... Sakura Laurel and the others looked super stable and crazy strong in the Arima Kinen, after all.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Personally, I feel like the Big Four
are already past their peak—"

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek!!
Maybe I should just step up and say,
"I'm standing right here, you know?!"...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. It's true that Laurel and the others are still strong, so let them say what they want.
Besides—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
From here on, all we have to do is prove it again.
Our strength, that is.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: ...Just as Bubble says.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Let us show the racing world.
What it truly means to be the new "Four Heavenly Kings."

...There is no panic in Bubble Gum Fellow's eyes.
If anything—

"Setting sights on what must be done, moving forward, and carving a path.
A dependable light that spoke volumes dwelt within her eyes."

Afterward, once we returned to the academy,
Bubble Gum Fellow and the others disbanded—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Well then.
We've got the rest of the day completely off, right?
choice_data_list: It's the New Year, so go on and rest your wings a while.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yeah, understood.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —So, what do you wanna do?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It's your day off, so you're resting too, right, Trainer?
Since we have the chance, let's do something together.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"......Ah!
You were totally planning on working, weren't you?!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"You can't do that, Trainer!
You've been working non-stooop since last year, so you're the one who needs to rest your wings!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
So with that said, no more work for today!
Got it?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's decide once more what we're going to do!
Trainer, I'd love to hear your ideas.
Hearing that, what came to mind was—
choice_data_list: ...For now, wanna grab something to eat?
Wanna play a game or something...?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, true.
It's about time to get hungry, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...In that case,
there's something I want to do.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, look, look, Trainer!
The mochi is puffing up!
choice_data_list: Oh... Such a beautiful golden-brown color...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Mochi grilled over a shichirin really is the best.
The way it puffs right up is just so adorable!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Back when I was in the club, we'd often
hold mochi-pounding events for the New Year.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
We used to toast mochi together just like this.
...Brings back memories.
choice_data_list: ...Was it really okay not doing it with everyone?
...Was it really okay not doing it with everyone?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Because today is—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Because it's a day off just for the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Ah, it's looking about ready! Here, this portion is yours, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna cover mine in lots of kinako
and dig in!
And so, I spent a peaceful New Year's time together with Bubble Gum Fellow—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Games! Sounds great!
I haven't played much since growing up,
so I'd love to play one after so long!
It was just a half-joking idea that came to me on the spur of the moment, but it was surprisingly well-received, catching me off guard. But now that it's come to this—
choice_data_list: ...Alright, I'll take it to the Trainer's Room.

text_block_list.text:
My personal game console is in my dorm room.
If I'm to play with Bubble Gum Fellow,
I'll need to bring it to the Trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hm? If it's in your dorm room, wouldn't it be faster to just do it there?
Let's head over now.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Come on, hurry up!
It'd be a waste to squander this precious time!
In the end, after quickly tidying up the room, I invited Bubble Gum Fellow inside, and the two of us played games together—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Go, long shot!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you blocked that just now!?
You're pretty good, Trainer-san!
choice_data_list: You pick things up fast too, Bubble...!
You pick things up fast too, Bubble...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thanks!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's been ages since I played video games
at someone's house like this.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'm having so much fun.
...Maybe it's because I'm with you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —An opening! Here's my killer shot!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Carelessness is your greatest enemy, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
All right, here it comes!
I'm going to win the next one too!

And so, the day was spent relaxing
and playing games with Bubble Gum Fellow—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Totally, totally! I'm so down!
Is there anything specific you wanna watch?
After all, I was intending to work until just a moment ago, so the truth is, I had absolutely no idea what movies were currently playing...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Then let's just decide once we get there!
We might have an unexpected encounter.

And so, the two of them arrived at the movie theater.
As they checked the lineup to see what was playing—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...! That is—

Following Bubble Gum Fellow's gaze,
I saw a poster for an anime movie
featuring cute, stylized chibi characters.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: So cute...! What is that design...!

...It looks like there's a screening of that movie
right after this with some open seats.
choice_data_list: Oh, should we watch it together?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Wait, really?! Are you sure?
choice_data_list: I guess you could say it was an unexpected encounter.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Awesome...! Let's go, then!

"And then the two of us will watch an animated movie
featuring lots of cute characters—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I feel sooo relieved and refreshed...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Not just the design, but the way it moves is so
squishy and cute, and how it tries its best, and...!
choice_data_list: You just can't help but cheer for them, huh?
You just can't help but cheer for them, right?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Exactly! Ahh, seriously,
I definitely have to hunt for their merch next time...!
And so, having gotten all excited, Bubblegum Fellow and I spent a wonderful time sharing our thoughts on the movie...
